paragraphs: Mentioned in Shabbat 12b according to the reading of Tosafot in Yoma 38b, s.v. "dela"; and our reading is Shavna.[^1]

notes.text: יב: and לח: give Shabbat 12b and Yoma 38b under the colon convention. Tosafot and s.v. are contextual expansions of התוס׳ and ד״ה; the lemma is דלא, dela. Shabbat is a full tractate name, not an abbreviation. Hyman attributes Shachna to Tosafot’s reading and reports Shavna as our reading. No new witness collation or independently checked locator/lemma is claimed, and no title is supplied.
